source.check: returned unopposed: 'The following members have been declared elected'; contests only in Cogry and Rashee (Ballymena Observer, 20 May 1927, p. 9, image-read)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 2 June 1927 in Cogry and Rashee only (the queue's nominal date of 26 May is the statutory date, not the poll). The other twenty-two divisions were declared elected without a contest, Antrim Urban returning two members (Ballymena Observer, 20 May 1927, p. 9). No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed.
